title: orphan .msg with no file_name skipped silently
description: cleanup_orphan_msg_files: when file_name() returns None for an orphan .msg (line 266), the file is silently skipped — no log, no quarantine. The file stays in the queue directory and will be skipped on every restart indefinitely, causing silent indefinite retention of undeliverable data. Should warn! and continue rather than silently skipping.
